decision_consequence.value: Cluster raw pain points from startup-idea-hunter-skill (CSV or JSON), eliminate Xiaoming-trap and desire/vitamin ideas, synthesize 3 evidence-backed product concepts via horizontal segmentation and vertical context/emotion timelines, and commit to 1 verifiable MVP direction with a 3-phase roadmap, bottom-up TAM, and 20-point validation checklist

decision_consumer.value: AI engineers, indie hackers, product builders, and solo founders screening raw pain clues harvested by startup-idea-hunter-skill before writing MVP code

environment_requirements.value: Python 3.9+ standard library only (csv, json, re, math, pathlib, argparse) for deterministic CSV/JSON ingestion, clue clustering, 4-gate screening, value reframing, and JSON/Markdown report generation

failure_impact.value: Falling into the Xiaoming Trap: spending months building a polished product for a broad audience where existing free tools suffice, manual user logging creates high friction, and 7-day retention and paid conversion collapse

objective.value: Screen, cluster, and reframe raw pain points from startup-idea-hunter-skill (CSV or JSON) into 3 evidence-backed product concepts and 1 verifiable MVP direction using the Easy-Vibe Finding a Great Idea methodology

problem.value: After hunting raw complaints and clues from forums using startup-idea-hunter-skill, builders have dozens of scattered pain points and need a structured Easy-Vibe Stage 1B skill to filter out Xiaoming Traps, cluster clues, apply horizontal segmentation and vertical context/emotion analysis, reframe value into 3 product concepts, and build a 3-phase verifiable MVP plan

success_measure.value: Ingests Hunter CSV or JSON clues, clusters related pain points, evaluates Xiaoming Trap risks and 5-tier workaround maturity, outputs 3 evidence-backed reframed product concepts (with horizontal segmentation and vertical emotion timelines) plus 1 verifiable product direction (with One-Person-One-Job-One-Entry positioning, 3-phase MVP plan, 3 concern mitigations, bottom-up TAM, 6-moat analysis, and the 20-item Appendix F demand checklist)
